experiments.mechanism: Selected probability-correction and Softmax bodies against dense FP64 expectations on supplied subsets.

conditions.execution: portable software FP32 lanes, optional native AVX512F/FMA selected-body execution
conditions.seed: fixed literal deterministic fixture, no RNG
conditions.oracle: Independent dense FP64 Q/K/V math; binomial sum for at-least-two-hit probability, source regularizer +1e-4, normalization and host weighted output.
conditions.qk_wv: host substitutes, not selected native kernels
conditions.native_exponential: actual polynomial and constants extracted and hashed; finite moderate shifted logits only
conditions.native_capabilities: AVX512F and FMA plus confirmed GCC identity; parent CPU/OS probe precedes native binary

experiments.note: Bootstrap support contract, not complete sampling/attention coverage. Actual transform and Softmax execute; supplied candidates and host QK/WV do not validate LSH or production dispatch. Portable and polynomial approximation tolerances are distinct.

experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3 and 4.4; implementation-specific BF16 arithmetic support
experiments.mechanism: Actual selected BF16 QK body on one complete tile against independently computed dense dots.

conditions.capabilities: AVX512F, AVX512BW, AVX512BF16 and GCC >= 11 confirmed before execution
conditions.oracle: Dense FP64 dots of fixed exactly BF16-representable operands, unsorted row IDs and canaries; absolute tolerance 1e-6.
conditions.storage_adapter: uint16_t alias matching archived FBGEMM Types.h; FBGEMM/Torch runtime unexecuted

experiments.note: Restricted full-tile fixture, not arbitrary tails/dimensions, BF16 conversion validation, full server dispatch or extension ABI/link validation.
